summary.text: Seven Seas Snake Woman is a rank seven demonic path Gu Immortal of Eastern Sea, counted among the six great beauties.

claims.text: A lovely laugh announces a female Gu Immortal approaching while Fang Yuan flees Song Yi Shi’s chase. The pursuers become alert and name her. She and Song Yi Shi are both publicly known among the six great beauties among Eastern Sea Gu Immortals. She has rank seven cultivation, is a demonic path Gu Immortal, and has conflicts with Song Yi Shi, but because of Song Qi Yuan’s power she does not dare to attack Song Yi Shi.

She owns seven sea areas. At this time the sea area they meet in is at a crucial moment when a large number of red tide fish are reproducing, so she has to stay and guard it. Fang Yuan chose the route because she was important to his plan. Narration calls her a beautiful but dangerous woman, very ruthless in her actions, and says the righteous path often leaks details of such people so others can be prepared.

She suddenly strikes, attacking Fang Yuan’s pursuers. Lei Hong shouts at her, then says he will block her while the rest continue chasing. He has rank seven cultivation and is not afraid of her; even though his battle strength is lower, he can stall her for a short time and escape. She does not know who Fang Yuan is and will not exert too much effort. Seeing Lei Hong step up, she shows disgust, stops on the spot, and calls him a meddlesome fool who likes to interfere. The other Gu Immortals detour around her and resume the chase.
She has an alluring body and a coquettish gaze as she answers Lei Hong.

During the fight for Ascending Heaven Plain, Song Yi Shi runs into her. She ridicules and slanders Song Yi Shi, saying her body is only worth six hundred immortal essence stones. Song Yi Shi’s mood sinks, and after returning she massacres a nameless island in a fit of anger.

She arrives at Qi Sea Ancestor’s banquet. Narration again calls her a beautiful but dangerous woman, very ruthless in her actions. Even though she is a lone immortal, she owns seven sea areas, which shows her strength. She is one of the six beauties of Eastern Sea’s Gu Immortal world, on par with Song Yi Shi.
